title: AI chats
description: Private AI chats on HKS: what was ordered, what runs, who uses the GPU and what was asked.

options.content:
### Private AI chats on HKS
Each chat is ordered from the Morpheus catalog and deployed by Argo CD. It gets its own share of GPU memory (Small 3 GB, Medium 4 GB, Large 8 GB), enforced by HAMi. Numbers follow the time range at the top right.

panels.title: Chats running
panels.description: Chats with all pods ready now.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", condition="true"}) >= 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Starting or waiting
panels.description: Chats that are starting, or waiting until enough GPU memory is free.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", phase="Pending"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU memory booked
panels.description: GPU memory promised to running chats, out of all GPU memory. A new chat waits when there is not enough left.

panels.title: Chats ordered
panels.description: Orders in this time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | what="Ordered" [$__range]))

panels.title: Chats removed
panels.description: Removals in this time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | what="Removed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Questions asked
panels.description: Chat questions in this time range, all chats.

panels.title: Activity: what was ordered, started and removed
Orders and removals
panels.description: Chats ordered and removed, per 10 minutes (longer on long time ranges).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | what="Ordered" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | what="Removed" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | what="Waiting for GPU memory" [$__interval]))
targets.legendFormat: Had to wait for GPU memory

matcher.options: Had to wait for GPU memory

panels.title: Activity log
panels.description: Every order, start, removal and problem, newest first. Kept for 7 days.

targets.expr: {job="events"} | logfmt | (namespace="argocd" and kind="Application" and name=~"ai-.+" and name!="ai-chat") or (namespace=~"ai-.+" and namespace!="ai-chat" and (reason=~"FailedScheduling|BackOff|Failed|OOMKilling|Evicted" or (reason="Started" and name=~"ollama-.+"))) | label_format chat=`{{ if eq .namespace "argocd" }}{{ .name }}{{ else }}{{ .namespace }}{{ end }}` | label_format what=`{{ if eq .reason "ResourceDeleted" }}Removed{{ else if hasPrefix "Updated sync status:  ->" .msg }}Ordered{{ else if eq .reason "Started" }}Ready{{ else if hasSuffix "-> Degraded" .msg }}Problem{{ else if eq .reason "FailedScheduling" }}Waiting for GPU memory{{ else if ne .namespace "argocd" }}Problem{{ else }}{{ end }}` | what != "" | label_format detail=`{{ if eq .what "Ordered" }}Order approved. Argo CD is deploying the chat.{{ else if eq .what "Ready" }}The model server started.{{ else if eq .what "Removed" }}Removed from Morpheus. Its GPU memory is free again.{{ else if eq .what "Waiting for GPU memory" }}Not enough free GPU memory. It starts when another chat is removed.{{ else }}{{ .reason }}: {{ .msg | replace "\"" "'" | trunc 120 }}{{ end }}` | line_format `{"Chat":"{{ .chat }}","What happened":"{{ .what }}","Details":"{{ .detail }}"}`

panels.title: Chats in the cluster now
panels.description: One row per chat. GPU memory booked is its share; used is what its model takes now (an idle model is unloaded after 5 minutes). Click the page to open the chat.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, owner, model, team, size) (count_over_time({namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", container=~".+"} [2m]))

sum by (namespace) (count_over_time({namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", container="webui"} |= "POST /api/v1/files/" |~ "HTTP/1.1\" 200" [$__range])) and on (namespace) sum by (namespace) (count_over_time({namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", container=~".+"} [2m]))

sum by (namespace) (count_over_time({namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", container="webui"} |= "audit:write" |= "/api/chat/completions" != "\"user\": {}" [$__range])) and on (namespace) sum by (namespace) (count_over_time({namespace=~"ai-.+", namespace!="ai-chat", container=~".+"} [2m]))

defaults.noValue: No chats running. Order one from the Morpheus Service Catalog.

panels.title: GPU: one NVIDIA T4 (15 GB), shared by HAMi
GPU busy
panels.description: How busy the GPU is, all chats together. Orange at 70, red at 90.

panels.title: GPU memory in use
panels.description: Memory the loaded models really use, all chats together. Orange at 70, red at 90.

panels.title: GPU memory per chat: booked and used
panels.description: Booked is the share HAMi keeps for the chat (its size). Used is what its model takes now.

panels.title: GPU over time
panels.description: GPU busy and GPU memory in percent.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: GPU temperature. Orange at 75, red at 85.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: GPU power draw. The T4 limit is 70 W.

panels.title: Questions asked
panels.description: Who asked what, with which model. Newest first. Click a column title to sort, or the funnel to filter.

targets.expr: {namespace=~"ai-.+", container="webui"} |= "audit:write" | regexp `audit:write:\d+ - +- (?P<audit>\{.*)` | line_format "{{.audit}}" | json user="user.email", body="request_object" | user != "" | line_format "{{.body}}" | json model="model" | regexp `(?s).*"role":\s*"user",\s*"content":\s*"(?P<question>(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"` | line_format `{"Chat":"{{ .namespace }}","Who":"{{ .user }}","Model":"{{ .model }}","Question":"{{ .question | replace "\"" "'" | trunc 300 }}"}`

panels.title: Pods ready
panels.description: Model server and chat page. 2 of 2 means it is up.

panels.title: GPU memory booked
panels.description: Its share of GPU memory. 0 means it is waiting for GPU memory.

panels.title: Questions
panels.description: Questions to this chat in the time range.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts. More than 0 can mean a problem.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory used by the chat now.

panels.title: Age
panels.description: Time since the chat was created.

panels.title: CPU of its node
panels.description: Share of the node CPU this chat uses. Orange at 70, red at 90.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$chat", container!=""}[2m])) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"} * on(node) group_left() max by(node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$chat", created_by_kind="ReplicaSet"} * 0 + 1))

panels.title: Memory of its node
panels.description: Share of the node memory this chat uses. Orange at 70, red at 90.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$chat", container!=""}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on(node) group_left() max by(node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$chat", created_by_kind="ReplicaSet"} * 0 + 1))
